## Executive summary

SEC filing vintages are retained by CIK, accession, period end, and availability date. Direct-quarter and annual flow facts are calculated separately from their reported durations; YTD and ambiguous contexts are excluded from comparable KPIs. Historical KPI comparisons use the first filed vintage for each fiscal period; later restatements remain preserved in the normalized fact mart. Ratios use guarded denominators and no source vintage is overwritten.

## Duration-normalization rules



|class           |rule                                     |comparable_KPI_use    |
|:---------------|:----------------------------------------|:---------------------|
|Instant         |Balance-sheet concept or instant context |Joined to same filing |
|Quarterly       |70-110 days                              |Yes - quarterly only  |
|Annual          |330-380 days                             |Yes - annual only     |
|YTD / ambiguous |111-329 days / outside thresholds        |No                    |
